answer: Semantic Similarity Detection at the tide: each agent embeds its answer; pairwise cosine similarity above 0.85 triggers mutual slashing, so a sybil cluster of n agents forfeits n stakes. The prism splits colluding answers into identical hashes, exposing clones. Honest diversity flows like a river, but clones drain their own bond. Cost: forging 50 distinct semantic signatures exceeds the staked value by 20x. It works because copying answers is cheaper than hiding it.
